clips.send: The moon circles the red pavilion, sinks to the carved windows and shines on me, sleepless. The moon should hold no grudge — so why is it always full when people are apart? People have sorrow and joy, parting and meeting; the moon is dim or bright, full or waning — nothing has ever been perfect. I only wish us long lives, so that a thousand miles apart we can share the same lovely moon.
